SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs normaldir.  Medial menisküs kök lokalizasyonunda yırtık izlendi. Menisküste hafif ekstrüzyon mevcut olup gövde kesiminde Grade 2 dejenerasyon zemininde horizontal yırtık izlendi.Ön çapraz bağ ve arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Medial eklem aralığında komşu femur ve tibiada marjin osteofitler mevcuttur. Kıkırdakta Grade 2-3 kondromalazi alanları izlenmektedir.Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Eklemde sıvı artışı saptanmamıştır. Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapıların sinyal intensiteleri doğaldır.Sonuç: Medial menisküste ekstrüzyon, arka kök yırtığı ve gövde kesiminde dejenerasyon zemininde kompleks yırtıklar, medial tibia femoral osteoartrit bulguları.

ΜΤ ΓΟΝΑΤΟΣ TEXNIKH:  Η εξέταση πραγματοποιήθηκε με ακολουθίες Τ1, πυκνότητας πρωτονίων με καταστολή του σήματος του λίπους και Τ2 βαθμιδωτής ηχούς. ΕΥΡΗΜΑΤΑ: - Από τον έλεγχο του έσω διαμερίσματος, παρατηρείται σημαντική εκφυλιστική οστεοαρθρίτιδα με ολική διάβρωση του αρθρικού χόνδρου σε έσω μηριαίο και κνημιαίο κόνδυλο (ICRS IV), παρουσία επιχείλιων οστεοφύτων και υπαρθρικού οστεομυελικού οιδήματος και εκφυλιστική ρήξη και μετατόπιση του έσω μηνίσκου. - Από τον έλεγχο του έξω διαμερίσματος, παρατηρούνται μικρά επιχείλια οστεόφυτα, ήπια επιφανειακή διάβρωση του χόνδρου και ήπια εκφύλιση του μηνίσκου. - Από τον έλεγχο του πρόσθιου διαμερίσματος, αναγνωρίζεται μετρία εκφύλιση του αρθρικού χόνδρου στην έξω αρθρική επιφάνεια και οστεόφυτο στην έσω αρθρική επιφάνεια της επιγονατίδας. - Ο έσω μηνίσκος σύστοιχα παρουσιάζει εξάρθρημα με εκφυλιστική ρήξη του οπισθίου κέρατος του. - Από τον έλεγχο των συνδέσμων σημειώνεται βλεννοειδής εκφύλιση και μερική ρήξη του πρόσθιου χιαστού συνδέσμου το πιθανότερο λόγω πρόσκρουσης από παρουσία οστεοφυτικού σχηματισμού από την έσω παρυφή του έξω μηριαίου κονδύλου, στην μεσοκονδύλια εντομή.  - Παρατηρείται μετρία ενδαρθρική συλλογή υγρού. - Σημειώνεται ευμεγέθης κύστη Βaker διαστάσεων 9.2εκ Χ5.9εκ Χ3.8εκ στη θέση του ψηλαφητού μορφώματος (κλινικό ερώτημα). - Μικρή κύστη στη μεσότητα του κνημιαίου πλατώ, στερείται κλινικής σημασίας.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Pain.
Comparison: [REDACTED].

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Mild degenerative subchondral cystic changes are present at the patella and trochlea. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Small, ruptured Baker cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: There is mild cartilage surface irregularity diffusely. Small osteophytes.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: There is mild cartilage surface irregularity diffusely. Moderate osteophytes.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: There is moderate to severe cartilage loss diffusely, lateral greater than medial with mild subchondral cystic changes. Moderate osteophytes.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 10 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:


1. Tricompartmental osteoarthritis, most prominent in the patellofemoral compartment.

2. Small, ruptured Baker cyst.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Dolor anterior de rodilla.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Menisco lateral de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Menisco medial con aumento de señal central de su cuerpo y cuerno posterior que no contacta la superficie
articular, sin caracteres propios de rotura.
Condropatía superficial de la región central de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral medial y del platillo tibial
lateral.
Cartílago troclear sin alteraciones.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial y total de la faceta lateral y vértice de la rótula con discretos cambios
óseos secundarios.
Mínimo derrame articular. No hay quistes poplíteos.
Leve aumento de señal de la inserción distal del tendón cuadricipital con probables pequeñas roturas
intrasustancia lineales.
Engrosamiento y aumento de señal de inserción proximal del tendón rotuliano, sin criterios de rotura
significativas.
Discreto edema del tejido celular subcutánea la región antero de la rodilla sin colecciones líquidas
categóricas.
No hay alteraciones de señal de la grasa de Hoffa.
Impresión:
Condropatía superficial de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral medial y del platillo tibial lateral.
Condropatía con lesiones grado 3 de la rótula.
Mínimo derrame articular.
Leve tendinosis cuadricipital distal con pequeñas roturas intrasustancia. Tendinosis rotuliana proximal.
Discreto edema del tejido celular subcutáneo de la región anterior de la rodilla sin colecciones líquidas
categóricas

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Left medial knee pain after tripping and striking left knee on a box at work.  History of RA. 
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.  

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES: 
Marked marrow edema in the lateral tibial plateau. Alignment is anatomic.  No aggressive osseous lesions.  

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst. 

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Radial oblique tear of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus with mild extrusion. 6 x 3 mm parameniscal cyst at the posterior horn, body junction. 
Medial compartment cartilage: Diffuse high-grade cartilage loss, weightbearing portion of the femoral condyle. 8 x 5 mm full-thickness cartilage defect posterior weightbearing portion of the femoral condyle. High grade partial thickness cartilage loss of the tibial plateau. 

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.  
Lateral compartment cartilage: Low-grade cartilage fraying spanning the lateral compartment. 

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT: 
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Mild heterogeneity of the patellar cartilage.     

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.  
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.  

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal. 
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.  
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal. 

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear. 
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear. 
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.  
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad.  No lateral patellar tilt or translation.  No patella alta.  Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 13 mm. 

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy.  Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact. 

SOFT TISSUES:
Edema identified in the medial subcutaneous fat. 
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle. 

IMPRESSION:
1.	Intense marrow edema in the medial tibial plateau. Findings may reflect contusion or severe osseous stress response/developing stress fracture.
2.	Radial oblique tear of the medial meniscus with mild extrusion.
3.	High-grade medial compartment chondrosis.
